name: A Sticky Situation
author: aliwagne
description: My submission for Game Jam #2. Get to the top of the starting platform. Controls: W A S D to move, SPACE to jump, LEFT-CLICK to use bubble gum roll (whip). My primary focus was 2d skeleton animations (instead of sprites), & using the (whip) for platforming. I really wanted to demonstrate how flexible and realistic this type of animation style is compared to traditional sprite sheets. In addition, I really wanted the "gum whip" to FEEL SUPER COOL. I strived to make platforming with and without the "gum whip" feel interesting and natural. If I had more time, I would have liked to add-in combat and puzzles using the "gum whip". Please note, I used all original assets.
